newsitem.title: USA: U.S. PCMI says holds Universal stake.
newsitem.headline: U.S. PCMI says holds Universal stake.

text.p: Private Capital Management Inc (PCMI), a Naples, Fla., investment adviser, and its president said on Wednesday they have acquired a 7.16 percent stake in Universal Hospital Services Inc.

In a filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission, PCMI and the executive, Michael Seaman, said they hold 410,800 common shares of Universal that they bought for $2.67 million. They said they hold the stake for investment purposes.
They said Universal Hospital, a Bloomington, Minn.,-based provider of movable medical equipment to hospitals, should take "proactive" steps to enhance shareholder value.

Such steps may include a possible business combination with a strategic or financial buyer, an extraordinary dividend, share repurchase, replacement of existing management members or nominating new persons to the board, they said.

They said they had discussed the issues with certain directors and officers of the company and may also discuss alternative means to raise shareholder value with shareholders, and the company's management and board.
